== Description ==

[[Ryan Jellison]] (front left, dark brown pullover, glasses, wavy salt-and-pepper hair), [[Amar Banger]] (center-right, olive Nike hoodie, hair bun, dark grey beard), [[Scott Lingrell]] (background left table: Scott Lingrell, Brian Fred, Ming Huo), [[Nathan Russell]] (background center table: Nathan Russell & Anthony Howard), and [[Anthony Howard]] (background center table, beard, black tee) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
